verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a broad API surface — creating/pre-creating inquiries, running verifications and reports, webhooks, and sandbox/simulate testing — covering most runtime operations available in the UI (persona-docs-1, persona-docs-18, persona-docs-21, persona-docs-27, persona-docs-9). However, Inquiry Templates and Workflows, which define screens, decisioning, and theming, are described only as configuration concepts with no evidence that they can be created or edited via API rather than the Dashboard UI, and Hosted/Embedded Flows are explicitly positioned as UI-driven paths. Missing for 10: API-based creation/editing of inquiry templates and workflow logic, and confirmation that Dashboard-only configuration screens have full API parity.
